descriptions.subject: Signpost
descriptions.text:
You see a weathered signpost. A weathered post with arms pointing off toward places. Fresh cuts cross the old grain.
Carved directions:
  - Morrowfast (3,6): from (2,6), 1 east world-map cells.
  - Cinderhold (6,6): from (2,6), 4 east world-map cells.
  - Posy (5,9): from (2,6), 3 east, 3 south world-map cells.
  - Gantry (7,8): from (2,6), 5 east, 2 south world-map cells.

descriptions.subject: WarlordCleaver
descriptions.text:
You see a warlord's cleaver. A snapjaw warband banner-blade, notched from a hundred raids. Heavier than it looks; meaner than it needs to be.
Damage: 1d10 per penetration.
Hit bonus: +0; Penetration bonus: +2.
Penetration uses Strength modifier (cap 50).
Attributes: Cutting Axe.
On damaging hits, independent attempts (targets may resist):
  25%: Bleeding - 1d2 damage a turn until staunched (save 15).
Equip slots: Hand.
  - Serrated: 20% chance to cause Bleeding on hit

descriptions.subject: IronshodBoots
descriptions.text:
You see an ironshod boots.
Armor contribution - AV: +2; DV: +0.
Speed: -5 while equipped.
Equip slots: Feet.

descriptions.subject: HealingTonic
descriptions.text:
You see a healing tonic (x2).
On whoever it takes hold of:
 - Heals 4d6+4 HP on the spot.

Drunk when used. Can be thrown - shatters over the target and adjacent tiles.
